title: Configure Hytexercise Wellness Break Routine
description: Configure Hytexercise to prompt regular desk-break exercise routines and track completion consistency.
prerequisites: You can access the Hytexercise Wellness Manager.
Notifications and timer prompts are enabled for your profile.
You have access to My Progress dashboard.
steps: Enable the routine scheduler and set recurrence to your preferred interval, such as every 60 minutes.
Select a short routine package, such as a 5-minute chair sequence.
Save settings and confirm the popup appears at the next scheduled interval.
Complete the guided routine when prompted and mark completion honestly.
Review My Progress to track Completed vs Skipped trends and adjust schedule for consistency.
validations: Timer prompts appear at configured intervals.
Routine completion events are recorded in My Progress.
Completed vs Skipped metrics update after each prompt cycle.
commonErrors: Prompts do not appear at the expected time.
Routine is configured but progress metrics do not update.
Users skip routines because interval is too frequent or disruptive.
recovery: Re-enable notifications and timer permissions, then test next trigger.
Save routine configuration again and verify dashboard refresh behavior.
Adjust interval or routine length to a sustainable cadence and monitor adherence.

faq.question: What interval should I start with?
faq.answer: A 60-minute trigger is a practical default for desk-intensive work and can be tuned later.

faq.question: How do I measure whether the routine is working?
faq.answer: Use My Progress completion trends and reduce skipped sessions over time.
